```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Bethel Township'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'township'
    AND wikidata IS NOT NULL
),
freeway_in_region AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry
  FROM roads r
  JOIN region_geom rg ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry, rg.geometry)
  WHERE r.highway = 'motorway'
),
clipped_freeway AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, f.geometry, true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  JOIN freeway_in_region f ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, f.geometry)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF', true) AS slope_rast
  FROM clipped_freeway
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS max_slope
  FROM slope_raster
),
longest_freeway AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM (
    SELECT id, geometry, ST_Length(geometry) AS length_m
    FROM freeway_in_region
    ORDER BY length_m DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS sub
)
SELECT
  (SELECT region_name FROM regions WHERE id = (SELECT wikidata FROM longest_freeway)),
  (SELECT max_slope FROM slope_stats)
```
